# Function findMatchingFunctionCall

  * findMatchingFunctionCall(events: [Event](../interfaces/Event.html)[]): [Event](../interfaces/Event.html) | undefined

Finds the function call event that matches the function response ID of the last event. Mirrors Python ADK's `find_matching_function_call`.

#### Parameters

    * events: [Event](../interfaces/Event.html)[]

#### Returns [Event](../interfaces/Event.html) | undefined
